operationalLogic: The AC Infinity Advance Grow System creates and maintains an optimal enclosed environment for plant cultivation. A central smart controller continuously monitors internal conditions (temperature, humidity, VPD) via integrated sensors. Based on user-defined programs and real-time data, it automatically adjusts the operation of connected hardware: regulating the inline duct fan's speed to manage air exchange, temperature, humidity, and odor; powering and dimming the LED grow light according to photoperiod schedules; and activating internal circulation fans for air movement. This intelligent automation ensures stable environmental parameters conducive to plant growth.

Circulation Fan(s) (dust removal from blades and grille)
